title: Today's quiz
caption: What you build today: a quiz from one article, in three stages, then a skill that makes the next quiz in one step.

steps.first: Pick one article you’d like your team to learn from. No article? The Workflow names a sample source.
steps.second: Open an AI chat, ideally Gemini or Claude; ChatGPT and Copilot work too.
steps.third: Open the quiz Workflow and pick “Turn a source into a quiz”. Look, don’t start yet.
steps.fourth: Not working after five minutes? Come back to the room early and we sort it out.

done: An article and an open AI chat, ready for the interview.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: On the page, pick “Turn a source into a quiz”. Each step there has the prompt to copy, in a chat version and one for an agent.

help.step: Before the hands-on: picking an article and opening my AI chat

talking-points.description: Show one or two example quizzes on screen share. The Workflow has three stages: Requirements (interview and spec), Execute (build and play the page), Improve (turn the run into a skill). Every check-in comes back here.
